$comment: A validation target: an external DPP model at one version, hosted as GITB validation types by OpenEPCIS DPP-Ready. Types are derived from the crosswalk profile; artifacts are checked against the vendor MANIFEST.json on every build. See docs/GITB_CONFORMANCE.md, section 'External models'.
title: BatteryPass-Ready data model

accepted.reason: Release 2.0.1 types the cell resistance as an integer number of ohms ($defs/ohmInteger); a cell's internal resistance is a fraction of an ohm (Amperia: 0.25 mOhm), so the only integer is 0, which would be false.

Release 2.0.1 requires a document on accidents unconditionally; a battery that has had none has nothing to link (Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, Annex XIII 4: information on accidents where they occurred).
